address: The Bloomsbury Hotel, 16-22 Great Russell Street, London,WC1B 3NN
bio: Treat yourself to a delicious Afternoon Tea at Dalloway Terrace. This stylish indoor-outdoor terrace is named after the famous character created by Virginia Woolf, an author synonymous with this sophisticated venue.  Located in the Bloomsbury Hotel, Dalloway Terrace is a quintessentially English environment that provides ideal surroundings to enjoy the great British tradition of Afternoon Tea. A beautiful al fresco space in spring and summer, this venue is also fully heated in winter meaning Dalloway Terrace is a destination guests can enjoy all year round.  Dalloway Terrace is delighted to serve a seasonal Afternoon Tea menu inspired by quintessential classics.  Dalloway Terrace at the Bloomsbury Hotel is situated right in the heart of London, near the shopping haven of Oxford Street, and just a short walk away from Tottenham Court Road station.
